name: Generate complete factory worker briefs with one command
description:
Factory review recommendation 7 of 20.

## Context

The supervisor assembles briefs through several calls and a hand-filled template, which has already drifted across workers.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add a command that assembles Story, Specs, Tasks, Comments, Epic, links, Stage Prompt, ROWBLY.md and Stage context.
- Produce a deterministic brief suitable for worker launch and include retry context when applicable.
- Update the factory skill to consume the generated brief.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/140 (head cf8e57f4). rowbly software-factory brief <KEY> now builds every section of a worker's brief after the template's rules. It covers the Story with each Plugin's Story Context section (ADR-0044: Tasks, Specs, Comments, Epic, Story links, Attachments, Assignees), the Stage Prompt, the Board's Stages, ROWBLY.md as inert text (ADR-0047, user-approved; amends ADR-0039 and the data model's no-read rule), --instructions-file and the --retry-file retry context. The output is deterministic. An incomplete context, a ROWBLY.md that cannot be read (a symbolic link or not a file) or a retry without --retry-file exits 4 with details.incomplete, and opt-in --allow-incomplete lists every gap at the top. The factory skill runs brief in Start a Story; the worker-brief template keeps the rules, the ROW-63 retry context and the ROW-66 assigned-worker rule as the fallback. Checks: typecheck and lint pass, test:unit 78 passed, test:cli 20 passed. Manual checks covered complete, missing, symlinked, directory and corrupted-data cases. agentic-tui screenshots are in the PR comments.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/140. Adds a read-only Story Context (ADR-0044): each Built-in Plugin (Tasks, Specs, Comments, Epics, Story Linking, Attachments, Assignees) gives a section, and PluginContext.storyContext reads them all, listing every Plugin that failed to load or whose section failed or is partial in 'incomplete'. 'rowbly software-factory brief <KEY>' prints the context part of a worker's brief (Story with all sections, Stage Prompt, Stages, instructions and retry context). It is deterministic and exits 4 with details.incomplete unless --allow-incomplete is given. The factory skill uses it, and the worker-brief template (with the ROW-63 and ROW-66 rules) stays as the rules block and fallback. Not done yet: reading ROWBLY.md waits for the user's approval of a read-only exception; the brief leaves a placeholder for the supervisor. Checks: typecheck, lint, test:unit (78) and test:cli (20) pass.

comments.body: Supervisor plan review: Do not implement the proposed ADR/API changes yet. I asked the user to approve a narrow exception permitting ROWBLY.md to be read as inert text; AGENTS.md requires user approval to reverse accepted ADR guidance. While waiting, refine the smallest read-only context design and inventory existing pipeline fixtures; no user-dependent changes. Reserve ADR-0044 provisionally (ROW-59 has proposed 0043), recheck before publishing. Do NOT delete references/worker-brief.md: ROW-63 and ROW-66 are completing changes to it. Generated briefs must preserve their retry and assigned-worker rules; merge their landed changes before replacing skill steps, and retain template as human fallback unless separately agreed. --retry-file passing captured context is acceptable in principle; coordinate with ROW-63's actual text. A new cross-Plugin contribution hook and failing-contributor behavior touches Plugin loading/pipeline: extend an existing fixture test for failure isolation and preserved Plugin Data; 'no new test' isn't sufficient. Need plan for disabled/missing contributors and an explicit incomplete result rather than silently launching an incomplete brief. ROW-58 needs blocker reads without interpreting another Plugin's private bag, so report a narrow shared read interface proposal for that as well.
